(Studio: Katie Couric)  The record-setting rally of the stock market reported.  

(New York: Anthony Mason)  The historic market rally in response to rescue plans for the global financial crisis featured; Dow Jones statistics cited; details given of the US plan to buy government ownership in the banks to unlock the credit market, the role of the earlier rescue package and the emergency response in Europe from Germany, France and Britain.  [TRADER&nbsp- reacts.]  [ECRI Inst. economist Lakshman ACHUTHAN†- explains the credit system.]  [Assistant Secretary of Treasury Neel KASHKARI†- speaks about the equity plan to encourage participation.]  ["The Gartman Letter" economist Dennis GARTMAN†- says you need this speed.]  

(London: Mark Phillips)  The break in the financial cloud in Britain reviewed; details given about the government ownership plan with the firing of top bank executives without bonuses.  [BGC Partners market analyst David BUIK†- says Europe may adopt the plan from British Prime Minister Gordon Brown.]  [BROWN†- speaks about stability.]  

(Studio: Katie Couric, Anthony Mason)  The faith in the plan to buy up bank stocks to restore confidence discussed.

data.segment_title: Campaign 2008 / Obama vs. McCain / The Economy
data.segment_description: (Studio: Katie Couric)  Report introduced.   (Toledo, Ohio: Dean Reynolds)  Senator Barack Obama's new plan to jump start the economy featured; details given from the CBS Poll on the election standings of presidential candidates Obama and Senator John McCain and about the tenets of the Obama financial rescue plan with tax breaks for jobs.  [In Toledo, OBAMA&nbsp- says the question is are you better off than four years ago; states the plan begins with j-o-b-s; states we can spend some time rebuilding Ohio.]   (Studio: Katie Couric)  The column in today's "New York Times" in which Bill Kristol called for McCain to fire his campaign and go back to being an accessible presidential candidate quoted.   (Wilmington, North Carolina: Chip Reid)  McCain's new speech in his campaign featured; scenes shown from his rally.  [In Wilmington, North Carolina, McCAIN&nbsp- tells Americans your retirement is at risk and jobs are disappearing and the president will need experience and a plan of action; asserts we have 22 days to go and we have been written off!; says fight fight fight.]

(Studio: Katie Couric)  A deadly wildfire in Los Angeles and the outbreak of a second fire noted; map shown.  

(Lake View Terrace, California: Bill Whitaker)  The California wildfire featured; scenes shown of firefighters battling the flames, residents fleeing, a burning industrial site, windblown flames, the second blaze and a burned-out car.  [Two PEOPLE, L.A. County fire department battalion chief David CAROLAN†, deputy chief Mario RUEDA†- react to the fire.]
